claims.statement: Tom Allen and Bill Davis went into training for their fight on December 7, 1868.
claims.excerpt: Both pugilists go into training to-day. Bill Blake, alias

claims.statement: Bill Davis's fighting weight was 185 pounds, and Tom Allen would not carry so much.
claims.excerpt: Davis’ §ghting weight is 185 pounds. Allen will not carry so much.

notes: The trainer (Bill Blake) and the landlord case are not about Allen. The fight itself is recorded under the earlier match in article 298.
